(Currently Amended) 1. A computing device for mapping user movements captured by a capture device external to the computing device, to input events on the computing device, the computing device comprising: a display to display an application executing on the computing device; a client sharing module to: transmit video data of the application to a receiver device; and receive gesture data associated with the application, the gesture data based on movements of a user captured from a capture device communicatively coupled to the receiver device; and a mapping module to: map the gesture data into an input event on the computing device; and provide data simulating the input event to a sensor of the computing device, wherein the client sharing module is to establish a video channel between the computing device and receiver device and establish an input channel between the computing device and receiver device.

(Currently Amended) 2. The computing device of claim 1, wherein to map the gesture data into an input event on the computing device, the mapping module is to: retrieve a type of movement of the user from the gesture data; and determine the input event based on the type of movement, wherein the gesture data includes at least one movement signal recognized from the user.

(Currently Amended) 3. The computing device of claim 2, wherein when the type of movement of the user is a swipe movement the gesture data is mapped to a touch input event and data simulating the touch input event is provided to a touch sensor of the computing device, the touch sensor configured to receive input from gestures detected by the capture device.

(Currently Amended) 4. The computing device of claim 2, wherein when the type of movement of the user is a lean movement the gesture data is mapped to a rotate input event and data simulating the rotate input event is provided to a gyroscope of the computing device.

(Currently Amended) 5. The computing device of claim 1, wherein the client sharing module is to: establish a video channel between the computing device and receiver device; establish an input channel between the computing device and receiver device; and wherein the video data is transmitted over the video channel and gesture data is received via the input channel, wherein the input channel facilitates real-time interaction with the application.

(Currently Amended) 6. The computing device of claim 1, wherein to transmit video data of the application to a receiver device the sharing module is to: stream video displayed on the display of the computing device to the receiver device via the video channel, utilizing a wireless or wired communication protocol.

(Currently Amended) 7. The computing device of claim 1, wherein the client sharing module is to transmit updated video data to the receiver device based on the application updating in response to the input event.

(Currently Amended) 10. A method of mapping user movements captured by a capture device external to a computing device, to input events on the computing device, the method comprising: executing an application on the computing device, using at least one processor of the computing device; transmitting, from the computing device, video data of the application to a receiver device; receiving, at the computing device from the receiver device, gesture data associated with the application, the gesture data based on movements of a user captured from a capture device communicatively coupled to the receiver device; mapping the gesture data to an input event on the computing device; and providing data simulating the input event to a sensor on the computing device, wherein mapping the gesture data includes identifying the type of movement from the gesture data and the input event is determined based on this type of movement.

(Currently Amended) 11. The method of claim 10, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event on the computing device comprises: retrieving a type of movement of the user from the gesture data; and determining the input event based on the type of movement, wherein the gesture data is recognized using predefined gesture recognition techniques.

(Currently Amended) 12. The method of claim 11, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event further comprises: mapping the gesture data to a touch input event when the type of movement is a swipe movement.

(Currently Amended) 14. The method of claim 11, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event further comprises: mapping the gesture data to a rotate input event when the type of movement is a lean movement.

(Currently Amended) 16. The method of claim 10, further comprising: establishing a video channel between the computing device and receiver device; establishing an input channel between the computing device and the receiver device; and wherein the video data is transmitted over the video channel and gesture data is received via the input channel, with the input channel allowing for command input based on the user's gestures.

(Currently Amended) 19. The method of claim 10, further comprising: transmitting updated video data to the receiver device based on the application updating in response to the input event, enabling the application to reflect changes made via the input events continuously.
